examShortTricks: Trick 1: One-sided limits first: lim x→a⁻ and lim x→a⁺ must be EQUAL for the limit to exist — check both before answering any piecewise or |x| question.
Trick 2: Geometric meaning: the curve approaches the height L from both sides of x = a (holes allowed); physical: instantaneous behaviour as t → t0.
Trick 3: lim f(x) exists but f(a) undefined/unequal → removable discontinuity (a hole) — naming the type earns the mark.
